subject.title: [BUG] OpenAI Codex errors leak into user chat

question: Should this issue be resolved as parser support for top-level `detail` payloads only, or should OpenClaw also suppress/no-reply unconfigured Codex/provider failures at the routing boundary?
rationale: The parser gap is source-reproducible, but silently discarding unconfigured-provider failures changes user-visible diagnostics and provider-routing behavior.

options.title: Parser plus routing policy
options.body: Recognize `detail` payloads and define tested behavior for unconfigured-provider failures so raw JSON never reaches user chat while diagnostics remain available internally.

options.title: Parser-only repair
options.body: Land a narrow parser fix and track silent unconfigured-provider suppression separately as a product policy issue.

options.title: Document existing policy
options.body: Decline silent discard and document that upstream provider failures may surface as generic user-facing failures.

recommendation.title: Parser plus routing policy
recommendation.body: Recognize `detail` payloads and define tested behavior for unconfigured-provider failures so raw JSON never reaches user chat while diagnostics remain available internally.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and validated the adjacent raw provider-error delivery policy work, making them the best available owner for the remaining routing decision.
